Let me check if there's a test file with a dataset named "dsetname" and attribute "theattr". Let me also check if there's a way to build the library. First, let me look for existing test files that might have the right structure:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/hdf5 -name "*.h5" | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "=== {} ==="; strings "{}" | grep -l "dsetname" 2>/dev/null' 2>/dev/null | head -10</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
